name: yogitrack
description: YogiTrack - MERN stack yoga tracking application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "cross-env PORT=5000 npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm run install:all && npm run build
